long_biography.plain_text:
Laith Pharaon built Orca Holding around a value-investing approach to hospitality property. The group acquires performing or underperforming hotels, restructures management and financing, and repositions the assets as operating businesses. That model has supported partnerships with established hotel and members' club brands.

Pharaon has also moved from investing behind other operators to creating hospitality concepts. As co-founder and chief executive of SIX & SIX Private Islands, he leads a resort venture that gives each island its own identity. Its public proposition centres on thoughtful design, a strong sense of place and personalised guest experience.

uncertainties.detail: The evidence establishes a substantial family hotel-investment platform and Pharaon's own founder-led expansion through Orca. It does not establish that he inherited Orca or identify a transfer of specific core assets. Self-made — advantaged start is therefore used instead of inherited or inherited and expanded.

Public sources describe Orca as privately held and one transaction source describes it as owned by Pharaon, but they do not publish his current percentage interest or prove personal title to individual hotels. Hotels, developments, acquisition prices and financing are treated as company-level activities rather than personal wealth.

Current Companies House filings use Ghaith as the middle name. The existing biography, Wikipedia and some Spanish-language records use Gaith, which appears to be a transliteration variant. The official current Ghaith spelling is proposed.

Companies House confirms September 1968. The exact day and London city come from the existing exact Wikipedia profile; El País independently supports United Kingdom birth but not the city or day. The city and day are proposed above the acceptance threshold but below very-high confidence.

The owner record identifies Pharaon as Saudi Arabian, while multiple current Companies House filings identify him as British and resident in Spain. British is proposed only as a secondary nationality. No residence change is proposed because the filings and owner record refer to different countries and may reflect different dates or legal declarations.
The LinkedIn profile is verified through Orca's company page and exact role match. No exact personal Instagram or personal website was verified. The canonical company website is proposed separately.

Politics, controversies, allegations, legal matters, sanctions, private-family trivia beyond the business starting platform, powerboat racing, vessel research and transaction values presented as personal wealth are excluded.
